notes: Account: Axiom Copilot Systems — building an IDE copilot targeted at enterprise engineering teams.
Primary product: low-latency in-editor completions + streaming token experience; secondary: repo-wide search via embeddings.
Key ask: sub-50ms local completion p95 in editor for single-token streaming; end-to-end p95 target 80-120ms depending on model.
Background jobs: nightly embedding refresh across 35k repos (internal + customer forks) — target throughput 1.5-2M files/day. They want built-in batching + incremental refresh support.
Indexing pipeline: Kafka-based ingest -> transformer embedder -> FAISS index refresh. Needs support for pinned model versions during index rebuild to avoid drift.
Model/versioning: must be able to pin model families for production copilot traffic and roll forward with canary A/B; rollback policy required.
Deployment preference: Dedicated for steady-state runtime, Private (VPC/on-prem) for pilot with one regulated customer. IT flagged need for air-gapped installer for on-prem later this year.
Security: SSO/SAML mandatory, SOC2 required for sales, KMS integration for embedding encryption at rest, retention controls for ephemeral logs.
Cost sensitivity: embedding refresh cost is a big lever — want Redwood Optimize suggestions (quantization + batching) to hit cost targets without degrading recall on code search.
POC summary: running 2-week POC on Redwood Dedicated in us-west with a trimmed model (quantized) for streaming; engineering reported 60ms median, 140ms p95 with current config.
SE notes (Priya): testing KV cache for repeated prefix completions reduced token compute by ~28% in synthetic benchmark; promising for in-editor scenario.
Quote from CTO (call 2026-02-18): 'We need deterministic inference for enterprise customers — pinning + audit trail are non-negotiable.'
Legal: security questionnaire out, asked for ISO27001 evidence and encryption key handling details. Legal wants on-prem licensing terms before procurement board vote.
Ops: flagged network egress and large snapshot transfers during index refresh — asking about resumeable uploads and delta-only syncs.
Engineering ask: fallback routing to smaller model family on saturation, and ability to route by policy (latency vs cost).
Meeting artifacts: Fireflies call ff_20260302_0912 includes performance demo; drive deck has dedicated sizing worksheet.
Short-term success metrics: achieve sub-100ms p95 in-editor demo + embedding refresh cost under $0.0008 per file averaged across POC week.
Long-term: reserved capacity for production copilot + enterprise support for on-prem deployments to win regulated customers.
